$comment: Default rubric for wave4-style scheduled lanes. A claim is verified only against observed artifacts: files written (sha256 + mtime), git commits, tool-call receipts, and heartbeat freshness. Mirrors the hardened wave4-529-retry protocol: a claimed restart/done with zero observed activity is STALLED, never reported as complete.

done.note: Done requires artifacts: files written (with SHAs), test outputs, or commits. The 2026-10-02 02:11 UTC run recorded status=succeeded with zero lanes dispatched — the canonical claimed-done-did-nothing case this rule catches.

restarted.note: A restart receipt alone is not evidence. Completion requires observed activity AFTER the restart.

running.note: Heartbeat stale beyond 2x window with a 'running' claim counts as stalled.

fail_closed: Any evidence-gathering failure yields STALLED with an explicit note. We never verify on unknown state.
reroute: On STALLED: roll back partial effects to the checkpointed state, confirm the rollback by direct observation, then redo through a different legitimate route. Never hot-loop the same failing call.
